if (type == 'Existing'){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  df = MACT_existing(CAA_section = CAA_section, data = df, 
                     emissions = 'emissions', sources = 'sources',
                     national_N = national_N)
  df_mean = df %>% group_by(sources) %>% 
                              summarize(means = mean(emissions), 
                                        counts = n())
  if (all(df_mean$counts == 1)){
  source_fig = FALSE
} else {
  source_fig = TRUE
}
} else if (type == "New"){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  source_fig = FALSE
  df = MACT_new(data = df,  emissions = 'emissions', sources = 'sources')
} else if (type == "As-is"){
  df = data
  if (any(df$emissions == 0)){
    zero_warn = TRUE
  } else {
    zero_warn = FALSE
  }
  df_mean = df %>% group_by(sources) %>% 
                              summarize(means = mean(emissions), 
                                        counts = n())
  if (all(df_mean$counts == 1)){
    source_fig = FALSE
  } else {
    source_fig = TRUE
  }
}
